mapper.sql: execution_id, plan_id, detail_id, execution_no, execution_type, execution_status, planned_amount, executed_amount, execution_rate, planned_date, actual_date, delay_days, execution_efficiency, risk_level, execution_notes, org_id, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE execution_no = #{executionNo} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE detail_id = #{detailId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE execution_status = #{executionStatus} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE execution_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY planned_date ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE delay_days > 0 AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY delay_days DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE risk_level = #{riskLevel} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE execution_efficiency < #{efficiencyThreshold} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY execution_efficiency ASC
SELECT execution_status, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY execution_status
SELECT execution_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY execution_type
SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY risk_level

SELECT execution_type, COUNT(*) as executionCount, COALESCE(AVG(execution_efficiency), 0) as avgEfficiency, COALESCE(MIN(execution_efficiency), 0) as minEfficiency, COALESCE(MAX(execution_efficiency), 0) as maxEfficiency, COALESCE(AVG(delay_days), 0) as avgDelayDays FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY execution_type ORDER BY avgEfficiency DESC

SELECT execution_type, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN delay_days > 0 THEN 1 END) as delayedCount, COALESCE(AVG(delay_days), 0) as avgDelayDays, COALESCE(MAX(delay_days), 0) as maxDelayDays, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN delay_days > 0 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as delayRate FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY execution_type ORDER BY delayRate DESC

SELECT risk_level, COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(planned_amount), 0) as totalPlannedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(executed_amount), 0) as totalExecutedAmount, COALESCE(AVG(execution_rate), 0) as avgExecutionRate, COALESCE(AVG(delay_days), 0) as avgDelayDays FROM fund_plan_execution WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
mapper.update: UPDATE fund_plan_execution SET execution_status = #{executionStatus}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_execution SET executed_amount = #{executedAmount}, execution_rate = CASE WHEN planned_amount > 0 THEN ROUND(#{executedAmount} * 100 / planned_amount, 2) ELSE 0 END, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_execution SET actual_date = #{actualDate}, delay_days = CASE WHEN #{actualDate} > planned_date THEN DATEDIFF(#{actualDate}, planned_date) ELSE 0 END, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_execution SET execution_efficiency = #{executionEfficiency}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_execution SET risk_level = #{riskLevel}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_execution SET delay_days = CASE WHEN actual_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_date > planned_date THEN DATEDIFF(actual_date, planned_date) WHEN actual_date IS NULL AND CURDATE() > planned_date THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), planned_date) ELSE 0 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_execution SET execution_efficiency = CASE WHEN delay_days = 0 AND execution_rate >= 100 THEN 100 WHEN delay_days = 0 AND execution_rate >= 90 THEN 95 WHEN delay_days = 0 AND execution_rate >= 80 THEN 90 WHEN delay_days > 0 AND execution_rate >= 100 THEN GREATEST(80 - delay_days * 2, 0) WHEN delay_days > 0 AND execution_rate >= 90 THEN GREATEST(75 - delay_days * 2, 0) ELSE GREATEST(70 - delay_days * 3, 0) END, update_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_execution SET risk_level = CASE WHEN delay_days > 7 OR execution_efficiency < 60 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN delay_days > 3 OR execution_efficiency < 80 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0
